name: triage-router

fragments.text:
Pick the lane that fits best:
- billing: invoices, charges, refunds, plan changes, payment failures, pricing questions.
- tech: product not working, errors, bugs, how-to, configuration, integrations, performance.
- escalation: anything that needs a human specialist. Route here if the customer brings up lawyers, legal action, or a regulator; if they report a security or data problem such as a breach, leaked credentials, or lost data; if a big account (roughly $5k+ in yearly spend) sounds ready to cancel; or if they say they have already reached out several times (about three or more) and still have no fix. When unsure between a lane and escalation on an important account, prefer escalation.
